title: Bound federation persistence overhead and completed placement detail
outcome: Unchanged federation state avoids needless meta writes/digest work, and settled placement detail has bounded retention while minimal creation identity and unresolved reservations remain safe.
acceptance: Demonstrate unchanged-domain full/delta writes avoid unnecessary federation meta UPDATE/hash work without weakening committed-content/version fences.
Define and test completed-detail compaction that retains the minimal identity needed to prevent reuse; unresolved/uncertain reservations are never evicted or freed by retention.
